name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Set the focus ring to 4px wide with 8:1 contrast and a 150ms fade-in from 0% to 100% opacity. This balances crisp visibility for keyboard users with reduced motion sensitivity, meeting WCAG AAA for contrast while keeping the animation short enough to avoid distraction. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on high-DPI screens, but the fade smooths the visual impact without sacrificing usability.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring still risks triggering vestibular disorders for users who need reduced motion—static rings with no animation are the only safe choice. Test with a screen-reader user who has vertigo; if they can’t complete the task, the fade-in fails.

name: Ramp
text:
Set the focus ring to 3px wide with 7:1 contrast and NO animation. This meets WCAG AAA contrast while removing motion risks for vestibular-sensitive users. The trade-off is slightly less crisp visibility for some keyboard users, but static rings are the only safe choice for reduced-motion users—no animation beats a short fade.

name: Reader
text: Static rings fail keyboard users who need motion cues to track focus. A 150ms fade-in at 4px with 8:1 contrast meets WCAG AAA and avoids vestibular triggers—test with a screen-reader user who relies on motion to confirm focus. If vertigo is reported, reduce the fade duration to 50ms; if still problematic, offer a user-controlled toggle for motion.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 4px focus ring at 6:1 contrast, 1px outer stroke, 50ms fade-in—static fallback if vertigo reported. Owner: Ramp.
